content: Definition of data which shall be transformed If 1. an ISignal references a DataTransformation and 2. this ISignal references a SystemSignal and 3. the referenced SystemSignal is referenced by a SenderReceiverToSig- nalMapping in the role systemSignal or referenced by a ClientServer- ToSignalMapping in the role returnSignal and in the role callSignal then the VariableDataPrototype referenced by the SenderReceiverToSig- nalMapping or the ClientServerOperation referenced by the ClientServer- ToSignalMapping shall be transformed.
